methodology: Same 128x192x1 blocks, amplitude order per product, 4/8/12/16 bits and numeric error ceilings. Test centering and gamma independently. Gamma=1 control uses the same new header/decoder arithmetic. All metadata, exact exceptions and auxiliary columns counted. Twenty-four workers, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 and OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1. No concurrent imaging during timed encoding. Verification/export/imaging excluded from encode timings. Equal bounds do not imply equal achieved error.
cache_methodology: Previously read source, sequential fresh processes, no cache eviction or affinity. Shared host. Three repetitions for the median+adaptive-gamma proposal; other controls have one run.
